page_title: VEN 2-1 FIO | Venezia v Fiorentina 12/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Matteo Marchetti has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) latches onto a great cross but heads straight at Ionut Radu, who makes a comfortable save.
90+3' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) says more than he should have to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
90+3' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Matteo Marchetti ignores the protests.
90+2' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) hits a dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal from the promising free kick. His low shot is stopped by a well prepared David de Gea.
90+1' Cheick Conde is substituted due to injury. Eusebio Di Francesco gives a chance to Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia).
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Cheick Conde (Venezia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' Dodo (Fiorentina) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Matteo Marchetti's book.
86' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
85' Substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) in, Robin Gosens out.
84' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) was probably a bit loose with his words to Matteo Marchetti, who decides to show him a yellow.
83' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Gianluca Busio (Venezia) for a tough tackle.
83' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Gaetano Oristanio is replaced by Francesco Zampano (Venezia).
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alessio Zerbin walks off the pitch to be replaced by Cheick Conde (Venezia).
81' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
79' It's time for a substitution. Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) comes on in place of Marin Pongracic.
78' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Kike Perez will be replaced by Issa Doumbia (Venezia).
78' John Yeboah comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mirko Maric (Venezia).
77' 2 - 1 Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) collects a sweet pass and lashes the ball into the top left corner. It couldn't have gone in a better place.
75' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
72' John Yeboah (Venezia) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker over the bar.
71' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Matteo Marchetti signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Venezia players celebrate.
70' Wait! Referee Matteo Marchetti has indicated he is going to review the Venezia goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
68' 2 - 0 Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the left post.

68' What a sweet touch by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive to the left side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post.
66' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
65' Fali Cande (Venezia) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Fiorentina win a free kick.
63' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) replaces Amir Richardson.
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Cher Ndour as he is replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina).
60' 1 - 0 Fali Cande (Venezia) converts a killer cross with a strong and precise shot that goes across the goal and past the goalkeeper.
59' Golden chance! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
57' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
55' Neat link-up play between Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) and Lucas Beltran, but Ionut Radu reads the game well and the move breaks down.

54' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
53' Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Dodo (Fiorentina) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
53' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
51' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Matteo Marchetti has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' John Yeboah (Venezia) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post.
45+1' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle as Gianluca Busio (Venezia) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
43' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the right post.
42' Dodo (Fiorentina) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
40' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
38' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
35' Referee Matteo Marchetti sees the trip by Fali Cande (Venezia) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
34' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
33' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
29' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' The corner is swung in but Fiorentina can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.

27' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the right post. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
27' Dodo (Fiorentina) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
25' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
24' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
23' The ball is cleared after Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
19' Kike Perez (Venezia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
17' Neat passing move from Venezia in order to create new attacking opportunities.
12' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina).
9' Dodo (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ionut Radu, who smothers the ball.
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Venezia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick to Venezia.
6' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
2' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
2' Kike Perez (Venezia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
1' John Yeboah (Venezia) tries to find Gaetano Oristanio, but he puts too much power on the pass.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti is introduced as the referee for today's match.
